maria chen: On it — which change caused the sidecar flip?
sam lee: PR #3245 merged ~5m ago, added optional sidecar and a default true in values for the new chart version.
caroline ng: If it's just an optional sidecar we should be able to pin chart version and avoid a full rollback — don't want a DB migration rollback if unnecessary.

maria chen: Agree pin for now; I'll add a values override with chartVersion: 2.4.1 and set sidecar.enabled=false in the canary values.
caroline ng: :thumbsup: who can apply the patch?
maria chen: Patching the release now. Applying helm release patch via the deploy tool.

deploy-bot: Canary health now 0.98. Auto-unpause scheduled at change-window 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z. Manual hold remains available.
sam lee: Please add a release-note entry: "Reverted chart bump for payments-service due to sidecar CPU regression; investigating."
